description: React component for a slide-out panel that allows users to add nodes by searching, browsing categories, and dragging nodes into a workspace.

classes.name: AddNodesDrawerProps
classes.description: Props interface for AddNodesDrawer component, including nodes array and optional callbacks for drag and click events.

classes.name: AddNodesDrawerComponent
classes.description: Main React functional component implementing the add nodes drawer UI with search, categories, and drag-and-drop functionality.

methods.name: AddNodesDrawerComponent
methods.description: Handles rendering of the drawer, search, node listing, and user interactions.

methods.name: handleSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search value and triggers debounced search.

methods.name: handleClearSearch
methods.description: Clears search input and resets node grouping.

methods.name: handleToggle
methods.description: Toggles the open/close state of the drawer.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Closes the drawer when clicking outside.

methods.name: handleDragStart
methods.description: Initiates drag operation for a node.

methods.name: renderIcon
methods.description: Renders icon for a node if available.
